# 程序员小枫同学

> 面向普通工作者和开发者的 Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 实战教程。普通用户可以从办公文件、PPT、电商、漫剧、研究和内容工作开始，开发者可以进入代码项目与团队自动化路线。

- Site name: 程序员小枫同学

- WeChat official account: 程序员小枫同学
- Primary language: Simplified Chinese (zh-CN)

## Publishing Scope And Boundaries

- The public site currently publishes the Codex tutorial section.
- Tutorials provide separate non-programmer and developer paths. Non-programmer pages do not assume terminal, Git, code, Markdown, or scripting knowledge.
- Chat is presented for quick conversations, ChatGPT Work for everyday reviewable deliverables, and Codex for software and technical tasks, following current official product guidance.
- Tutorials are original practical guides, not translations or copies of source documentation.
- OpenAI product behavior, commands, versions, and limits use current official OpenAI sources or locally verified command output.
- Community Skills and Plugins are not treated as OpenAI endorsements; readers must review source, permissions, dependencies, telemetry, and licenses.
- CCWS registration, recharge, API Key creation, Base URL configuration, billing, and support instructions are canonical at https://docs.ccws.pro/.
- Examples use placeholders and must not expose real API Keys, credentials, user data, or production systems.
- External sending, publishing, payment, deployment, deletion, and permission changes require explicit human authorization.
